mapper.select: SELECT id, msg_id, chat_type, CAST(external_userids AS TEXT) AS external_userids, CAST(sender_list AS TEXT) AS sender_list, CAST(content_json AS TEXT) AS content_json, status, send_result_json, crm_survey_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM crm_wecom_mass_task ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id FROM crm_wecom_mass_task WHERE status = 'created' AND msg_id IS NOT NULL AND msg_id != '' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, msg_id, chat_type, CAST(external_userids AS TEXT) AS external_userids, CAST(sender_list AS TEXT) AS sender_list, CAST(content_json AS TEXT) AS content_json, status, send_result_json, crm_survey_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM crm_wecom_mass_task WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_mass_task ( msg_id, chat_type, external_userids, sender_list, content_json, status, send_result_json, crm_survey_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{msgId}, #{chatType}, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{externalUseridsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') AS jsonb), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{senderListJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') AS jsonb), CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(#{contentJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '') AS jsonb), #{status}, #{sendResultJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{crmSurveyId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
